name: APEMAGA
fix_description: Remove the family function entirely. It allows anyone to burn 99.9% of any address token balance via the misleadingly named _approve_ internal function. No legitimate use case exists for burning other users tokens. If a burn mechanism is needed, restrict to msg.sender burning their own tokens only.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a very short, single-pool manipulation with only a few obvious steps: buy the token, call the vulnerable function repeatedly on the pair, sync reserves, and dump back to WETH. It does not require flash loans, complex routing, or deep protocol-specific reasoning beyond noticing the token contract can improperly alter the LP pair balance/state.
